retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat (RetroArch, FinalBurn Neo)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, BCD, eight bytes after player 1's as in Metal Slug 4 and 5 (a two-player game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack, Metal Slug 3's code: 300, 400, 1100 then 1300 as the 2UP on his screenshots)

lives.note: player 1 lives, like the 1UP on screen (verified)

lives_p2.note: player 2 lives, like the 2UP on screen (verified)

weapon.note: player 1 weapon (cheat database Select Shot Equipment PL1): 0 handgun, 1 MS cannon, 2 shotgun, 3 rocket launcher, 4 flame shot, 5 heavy machine gun, 6 laser, 7 to 11 the SUPER shotgun, rocket launcher, flame shot, machine gun and laser, 12 enemy chaser, 13 iron lizard, 14 drop shot, 15 super grenade, 0x15 fat enemy chaser; the Metal Slug 6 hack starts with 17 and comes back to it when the ammo runs out, ARMS infinite on its screen: its handgun (hd per_game weapon_codes, a game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack (mslug3b6, Metal Slug 3's code with the missions in another order; memory recording, capture, 201 screenshots, 1.33 test 46))

weapon_p2.note: player 2 weapon, same codes (cheat database Select Shot Equipment PL2)

prisoners.note: player 1 rescued prisoners (cheat database, Always have 15 Prisoners PL1)

prisoners_p2.note: player 2 rescued prisoners (cheat database, Always have 15 Prisoners PL2)

p1_chr.note: player 1 soldier (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 Character, address swapped): 0 Marco, 1 Tarma, 2 Eri, 3 Fio as in Metal Slug 2, the order to confirm in game

p2_chr.note: player 2 soldier, deduced: his block is 0xB0 further (lives, invincibility and body of the cheat database)

form.note: player 1 body: 0 or 1 normal, 2 fat, 3 mummy, 4 and 5 diving, 6 snowman, 7 zombie, 8 flying, 10 in space (cheat database Select Body Type PL1, RetroAchievements P1 form)

form_p2.note: player 2 body, same codes (cheat database Select Body Type PL2)

vehicle_kind.note: player 1 vehicle code (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 Vehicle, address swapped): 0 outside the game, 1 on foot, 8 Slug Mariner (the submarine, 57 s of a game of 7 November 00:48 against his screenshots), 4 the Slugnoid (286 s, the mech before the Huge Hermit; the notes say tank for 4), 6 Slug Flyer, 7 Slug Copter, 9 Drill Slug, 10 'robot', 11 Astro Slug per the notes, unverified

vehicle.note: player 1 in a vehicle: the same byte less one, 0 on foot or outside the game, 3 and more in a vehicle (what the HD screen reads to put him aboard)

vehicle_kind_p2.note: player 2 vehicle, same codes, deduced (0xB0 further, six bytes after his lives)

vehicle_p2.note: player 2 in a vehicle, the same byte less one

_p1b.note: probe (1.33 test 21): player 1's block around his lives and vehicle, to find the vehicle's energy and missiles from a capture

_eq1.note: probe (1.33 test 21): after the two equipment blocks (weapon, bombs, ammo), where the vehicle's own may be

_eq3.note: probe (1.33 test 21): same, up to the 'mounting or in vehicle' bit of the RetroAchievements notes (0x10EB3A)

_st1.note: probe (1.33 test 21): the status block (prisoners 0x10ED05, 'P1 Vehicle' 0x10ED06 of the notes, score 0x10ED18)

_vf1.note: probe (1.33 test 21): the 'vehicle flag' of the RetroAchievements notes (0x10A095) and the enemies on screen

mission.note: mission number, 0-based in RAM (cheat database "Select Starting Mission"), missions 1 to 5: another value is not read (Metal Slug read 183 while it booted). The Metal Slug 6 hack plays them in another order (3 then 1 in RAM for its MISSION 1 and 2, a game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack (mslug3b6, Metal Slug 3's code with the missions in another order; memory recording, capture, 201 screenshots, 1.33 test 46)): the HD screen counts the missions played in that game (hd per_game mission_count), the bosses keep Metal Slug 3's names

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

p1_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 1 stick and buttons (P1CURRENT): 0x04 left, 0x08 right, 0x10 A. Fires the handgun and scrolls the HD backdrop, to be confirmed in game

p2_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 2 stick and buttons (P2CURRENT), same bits

grenades_out.note: player 1 grenades on screen (1.33 test 40, the recording of 7 November 00:48): 1 or 2 right after each bombs decrease, back to 0 as they blow up, 0 the rest of the time, five bytes before his bombs

grenades_out_p2.note: player 2 grenades on screen, deduced: his equipment block is 0x0E further (bombs 0x10EB03), to confirm in a two-player game

_hps.note: the lives of the game's objects (1.33 test 40, from the memory recording of 7 November 00:48 with its screenshots): a table of 176-byte entries, the life word at the same offset as the RetroAchievements note 'Enemy HP (Slot ???)' 0x10146B (its two slots are 21 entries apart); Huge Hermit came with 5000 in two entries at once (0x10146A and 0x10259A, the same value all along, one of them a twin), the soldiers hold 10 to 60, bigger enemies 100 to 800; an empty entry holds 0

end_text.note: probe: the routine of the text object the game creates for MISSION n COMPLETE in mission 1 (29166 from 397.4 s to 401.8 s of a game of 7 November 00:48; 29178 for MISSION 2 START), in the object table; mission 4 writes its text elsewhere with another code (29210 in several objects, a game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack (mslug3b6, Metal Slug 3's code with the missions in another order; memory recording, capture, 201 screenshots, 1.33 test 46)), so MISSION COMPLETE is read on end_count since test 46

end_count.note: the game's end-of-mission counter (RetroAchievements note 'Counters related to the end of the stage'): 65535 while playing; 26 to 0 over the boss's wreck, then about 150 to 0 while MISSION n COMPLETE is written, 41 to 0 on the fade, 18 to 0 on the next MISSION START (153 at 397.4 s of a game of 7 November 00:48, mission 1, the text on his screenshot of 400 s; 155 at 281.9 s of a game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack (mslug3b6, Metal Slug 3's code with the missions in another order; memory recording, capture, 201 screenshots, 1.33 test 46), its first mission being Metal Slug 3's mission 4): mission_done when it enters 100..200

hd.note: where the bosses' lives are: the whole table of objects (_hps). The entry filled with the life the mission's boss starts with (boss_life: the Huge Hermit 5000 from a game of 7 November 00:48, mission 1; Sol Dae Rokker 4000 in mission 4, one entry, from a game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack (mslug3b6, Metal Slug 3's code with the missions in another order; memory recording, capture, 201 screenshots, 1.33 test 46)) is the boss, named after the mission; in a mission not listed yet, a life of boss_min or more; any other life of 200 or more is a big enemy with a quiet bar. mission_done (end_count) shows MISSION COMPLETE when the game writes it

mslug3b6.note: the Metal Slug 6 hack: MISSION n counts the missions played in the game (its first is Metal Slug 3's mission 4, its second mission 2, a game of 8 November 20:40 on the Metal Slug 6 hack (mslug3b6, Metal Slug 3's code with the missions in another order; memory recording, capture, 201 screenshots, 1.33 test 46)), weapon 17 is its handgun
